connector.name: Propraven
connector.registryDescription: Property intelligence: 180M+ US parcels - lookup, search, owners, hazards, permits, deeds.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.propraven.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jdw2111 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

env.description: Your PropRaven API key (pz_...). Get one at https://propraven.com/dashboard.
